newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Shares of Jinro affiliates limit down on default.
newsitem.headline: Shares of Jinro affiliates limit down on default.

text.p: Shares of South Korea's Jinro Group affiliates -- Jinro Industries Co, Jinro General Foods Co and Kumbi Co Ltd -- fell by their limit in morning trading on news of a default by Jinro Ltd, brokers said on Tuesday.
Jinro Industries fell to its daily limit low of 4,920 won, down 420, an hour after morning trading began, while Jinro General Foods lost 360 won to a low of 4,240, they said.
Kumbi dropped to a permissible low of 31,300 won, down 1,700.
"The listed affiliates of Jinro were all badly hit by Jinro's debt default news," said Roh Chang-yeul of Samsung Securities.
Brokers said the shares were likely to continue down for most of the day.

The Commercial Bank of Korea, the prime creditor to Jinro Ltd, announced Jinro has defaulted on promissory notes and cheques, but all of Jinro's bank accounts would remain open under an agreement among South Korean financial institutions to prevent further corporate failure following two major collapses this year.
Earlier this morning, the Korea Stock Exchange suspended trading in common and preferred shares of Jinro Ltd on rumours that the company had defaulted on debt repayments.
The timing for resumption of trading has not yet been set.
